description: This PHP source file defines the class `SugarFieldFile`, which extends `SugarFieldBase` and manages file-related fields in the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering view templates, handling file uploads, duplication, and remote linking, as well as internal configuration for file display options.

classes.name: SugarFieldFile
classes.description: A class responsible for managing file-related fields within the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM system, including rendering views, handling uploads, and configuration of file options.

methods.name: fillInOptions
methods.description: Configures display and behavior options for file fields, such as EAPM allowances, document type IDs, and module link overrides.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the detail view of a file field.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the edit view of a file field, including setting access keys.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the search view template for a file field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the file upload, duplication, removal, and remote linking logic associated with the file field.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the list view rendering for the file field.
